def rollout(controller):
    ''' env, rnn, vae are '''
    ''' global variables '''
    obs = env.reset()
    h = rnn.initial_state()
    done = False
    cumulative_reward = 0
    while not done:
    z = vae.encode(obs)
    a = controller.action([z, h])
    obs, reward, done = env.step(a)
    cumulative_reward += reward
    h = rnn.forward([a, z, h])
    return cumulative_reward
